basic_details.job_title: KSCSTE-SRIBS Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: KSCSTE-Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences (SRIBS), Kottayam, an institution under the Kerala State Council for Science, Technology & Environment, has invited applications for 1 Project Fellow in the "KSCSTE-Emeritus Scientist Scheme". The post requires an MSc in Physics and pays 32,560/- per month for 3 months or till the end of the scheme, whichever is earlier. The post is open only to permanent residents of Kerala, who must apply online through the Google Form on https://sribs.res.in on or before 2 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the Google Form provided on the official website of KSCSTE-SRIBS, Kottayam, https://sribs.res.in, on or before 2 December 2026. The notice names no other steps and lists no documents to attach. For telephonic enquiry, the notice gives 0481-2500200. It also prints the institute email [email protected] on the letterhead.

content_sections.heading: About KSCSTE-SRIBS
content_sections.text: KSCSTE-Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences is a Research & Development institute under the Kerala State Council for Science, Technology & Environment (KSCSTE). Its address is Pi Hills, 8th Mile, Velloor P.O., Kottayam – 686501. The notice is dated 12 November 2026 and is signed by the Director, Suresh C H.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification printed for the Project Fellow post is MSc in Physics with CGPA above 4 out of 5 or above 80%, with a passion for experimental research in materials/nano sciences. Age: below 40 years, with relaxation as per Govt. rules. The notice does not print the amount of relaxation or a date for counting age. Residence: the applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is 32,560/- per month. The appointment is temporary and on contract basis. Its duration is 3 months or till the end of the scheme, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSCSTE-SRIBS Project Fellow
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the Google Form provided on the official website of KSCSTE-SRIBS, Kottayam, https://sribs.res.in , on or before 2 December 2026. The notice names no other steps and lists no documents to attach. For telephonic enquiry, the notice gives 0481-2500200. It also prints the institute email [email protected] on the letterhead.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that selection will be based strictly on academic merits and expertise. It does not describe an interview or any other stage.
